title: Describe and account for preferred stock

items.concept: Initial recognition of callable and convertible preferred as equity and mandatorily redeemable as liability; subsequent accretion schedule; multi-year period-end adjusting interest JEs (emphasis); call, conversion, and maturity settlement
Number-variant twin: equity preferred issuance, conversion, call with RE charge; mandatorily redeemable liability with 4-year accretion schedule and multi-year period-end adjusting JEs

Multi-year period-end adjusting JEs for already-outstanding mandatorily redeemable preferred; current/noncurrent presentation; issuer call of equity preferred; book-value conversion when common par exceeds preferred carrying amount; classification of callable vs holder-redeemable vs mandatory
Period-end adjusting JE for mandatorily redeemable preferred stock with fixed amount and fixed date
Accounting for call/recall of equity preferred when cash paid exceeds carrying amount
